intro.title: What do your small loves say about you?
intro.body: Pick a mode: personal synergy, combo matchup, or a weekly status report — get a score and a witty insight. Everything stays in your browser.

steps.joyHint: A small love that sparks a smile without trying
steps.viceHint: A habit, treat, or little escape you know well
steps.moodHint: The emotional tone coloring your day

result.caption: Life synergy score
result.shareText: My life synergy score: {{score}}% — {{insight}} | Everyday Love Calculator on DailyLogic
